about: Reviewed corrections to district names in the official district atlas (districts.geojson), applied by canonical_data.canonical_districts before polygons that share a name are merged. A polygon is renamed only when its current name is also carried by another polygon in the same city and an independent source places it in a district that already exists in the atlas under the corrected name. A correction may also move a polygon to the city it lies in (to_city_en / to_city_ar); directory records filed under the old city with that district name then go to the nearer of the two districts by their coordinates. A correction may also give a district its place name (qualifier_ar / qualifier_en) to tell it from a same-name district of the same city: «العزيزية (بحرة)» beside Jeddah's own العزيزية.

about_n910_names: Reviewed links from an atlas polygon to the name 910ths gives its district, read only by build_910ths_reference.py; they never rename the atlas district. Left unlinked on purpose: a polygon whose point falls in another district (different boundaries), one 910ths district read in two cities (الحمراء Dammam/Al Khobar, جامعة الملك فهد للبترول), and atlas districts 910ths splits into numbered parts (البلد2, الأمل 1).

n910_names.evidence: The 910ths demographic map, opened at a point inside this polygon, names the same district with another spelling; no other atlas polygon reads it. Checked 2026-10-27.
